## 分析目的

合併 **109–113 年**家庭面問卷，擴大樣本基礎後，
以 **年齡組（X 軸）× 國籍（Y 軸）** 交叉繪製加權失聯率熱力圖。
每格數值為「**該年齡 × 國籍組合的加權失聯率**」（分母：三年全樣本同格雇主，分子：其中曾失聯者）。

> 三年各調查的 q5（「過去六年內是否曾發生失聯」）題目結構與選項編碼一致，可直接合併。

---

## 資料說明

| 欄位 | 說明 | 編碼 |
|------|------|------|
| `q5` | 過去六年有無失聯 | 1=沒有，2=有（各年問卷相同） |
| `q8b` | 看護工年齡 | 1=未滿25歲，2=25–34歲，3=35–44歲，4=45歲以上 |
| `q8d` | 看護工國籍 | 1=印尼，2=越南，3=泰國，4=菲律賓 |
| `w` | 推估權數 | — |

---

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(showtext)

font_add_google("Noto Sans TC", "NotoSans")
showtext_auto()
```

```{r load-data}
base_dir <- if (basename(getwd()) == "reports") ".." else "."
data_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "data")

# ── 合併 109–113 年家庭面資料 ─────────────────────────────
load_year <- function(year) {
  read_csv(
    file.path(data_dir, paste0(year, "年移工/家庭面/data", year, ".csv")),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) %>%
    transmute(
      survey_year = as.integer(year),
      w           = as.numeric(w),
      had_missing = as.integer(q5 == 2),
      age_code    = as.integer(q8b),
      nat_code    = as.integer(q8d)
    )
}

d <- bind_rows(
  load_year("109"),
  load_year("110"),
  load_year("111"),
  load_year("112"),
  load_year("113")
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_code), !is.na(nat_code),
         !is.na(w), w > 0,
         age_code %in% 1:4, nat_code %in% 1:4)

age_labels <- c("1" = "未滿 25 歲",
                "2" = "25–34 歲",
                "3" = "35–44 歲",
                "4" = "45 歲以上")

nat_labels  <- c("1" = "印尼",
                 "2" = "越南",
                 "3" = "泰國",
                 "4" = "菲律賓")

d <- d %>%
  mutate(
    age = factor(age_labels[as.character(age_code)],
                 levels = age_labels),
    nationality = factor(nat_labels[as.character(nat_code)],
                         levels = rev(nat_labels))  # Y 軸由上到下
  )
```

```{r compute-heatmap}
heat <- d %>%
  group_by(nationality, age) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total    = n(),
    n_missing  = sum(had_missing),
    wtd_miss_rate = weighted.mean(had_missing, w, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # 標注文字：顯示失聯率與樣本數
    label = if_else(
      n_total >= 10,
      paste0(percent(wtd_miss_rate, 0.1), "\n(n=", n_total, ")"),
      paste0("—\n(n=", n_total, ")")   # 樣本過少，不顯示比率
    ),
    # 樣本過少格位以 NA 處理，避免誤導
    rate_display = if_else(n_total >= 10, wtd_miss_rate, NA_real_)
  )
```

---

## 熱力圖：加權失聯率

```{r heatmap, fig.width=10, fig.height=6.5}
p_heat <- ggplot(heat, aes(x = age, y = nationality, fill = rate_display)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label,
        color = if_else(!is.na(rate_display) & rate_display > 0.06,
                        "white", "#333333")),
    size = 5.5, fontface = "bold", family = "NotoSans", lineheight = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low      = "#FFF3E0",
    high     = "#DE4429",
    na.value = "#f0f0f0",          # 樣本不足格：淡灰
    name     = "加權失聯率",
    labels   = percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "bottom") +
  labs(
    title    = "年輕移工、越南籍看護工的失聯率明顯偏高",
    subtitle = "109–113 年家庭面問卷合併（總 N≈20,110）；各格數值為加權失聯率（分母：全樣本同格雇主）\n灰色格位表示該組樣本不足 10 人，不呈現比率",
    x        = "看護工年齡",
    y        = NULL,
    caption  = "資料來源：勞動部移工管理及運用調查，109–113 年家庭面；以抽樣權重 w 計算"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "NotoSans", base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 13, color = "#555555",
                                      margin = margin(b = 12)),
    plot.caption       = element_text(color = "#aaaaaa", size = 11),
    axis.title.x       = element_text(angle = 0, size = 14,
                                      margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.title.y       = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    axis.line          = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks         = element_blank(),
    legend.position    = "right",
    legend.title       = element_text(size = 13),
    panel.background   = element_blank()
  )

p_heat
```

---

## 輔助：各格樣本數

```{r sample-table}
heat %>%
  select(nationality, age, n_total, n_missing, wtd_miss_rate) %>%
  mutate(wtd_miss_rate = percent(wtd_miss_rate, 0.1)) %>%
  rename(
    國籍     = nationality,
    年齡組   = age,
    總樣本數 = n_total,
    失聯案例 = n_missing,
    加權失聯率 = wtd_miss_rate
  ) %>%
  arrange(國籍, 年齡組) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "各格樣本數與失聯率明細")
```

dir.create(plots_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(file.path(plots_dir, "109_113_missing_heatmap_age_nationality.png"),
       plot = p_heat, width = 10, height = 6.5, dpi = 150)
